Maria (AE): Heads up — customer wants an updated data flow diagram + subprocessor matrix for the EU POC. They explicitly asked about logging, backups, and cross-border egress. Need this by EOD CET. Can someone own?

Dan (SE): I'll take it. Quick q: are we showing Hosted + Dedicated + Private variants or just the Private setup for their compliance team?

Maria (AE): Start with Private and Dedicated. Add a small note about Hosted fallback but mark it as 'not in scope' for EU-only reqs.

Dan (SE): Got it. For subprocessors, do we include cache/CDN providers and metrics pipeline? They asked about backups too.

Olivia (Security): Include all subprocessors that touch PII or inference inputs: object storage, metrics/telemetry, log ingestion, KMS provider. For backups, note whether snapshots are encrypted with customer KMS — for Private we can support customer KMS/HSM.

Dan (SE): Re: egress — should we show control plane (metadata only) going to US? For Private we keep control plane in EU; Hosted control plane lives in multiregion. I'll mark control plane as 'customer-option: EU-only' where applicable.

Sam (Eng): Reminder: if they enable model telemetry for performance, that will flow to our telemetry service (metrics-redwood) — make sure it's optional and documented. Also retention defaults -> 90 days for logs, 30 for traces unless ops config changed.

Maria (AE): :thumbsup: Include a short rows table: subprocessors, purpose, location, compliance attestation (SOC2/ISO27001). Also they requested CAIQ/SIG mapping; we can attach the CAIQ extract.

Olivia (Security): I'll add the CAIQ references + call out relevant controls (e.g., TLS, at-rest AES-256, KMS integration, access reviews). Also flag that Hosted ingestion may use third-party CDN (eu-region) but backups might be replicated to provider's US storage unless customer requests EU-only.

assets-bot: Uploaded: diagram_draft_v1.png -> https://redwood.internal/share/abc123 (permissions: sales,security,eng).

Dan (SE): Thanks — I'll iterate on diagram and subproc spreadsheet. Will send updated diagram + subproc CSV in thread in ~45m.

Maria (AE): Perfect. I'll prep the cover note for their vendor risk team explaining where we can commit and where we need customer sign-off. Tag me when ready @Maria (AE).
